architectureDecisions: PostgreSQL = relational source of truth (users, schools, identities, sessions, classes, enrollments, audit, storage metadata, canonical tags catalog, career/study catalog, idempotency keys, outbox, validation decisions, rubric assessments, verification records)

MongoDB = dynamic evidence store (PortfolioItemDocument aggregate, PortfolioRevisionDocument point-in-time snapshots, EvidenceTagSnapshotDocument approved projections, RecommendationSnapshotDocument immutable snapshots, DerivedProfessionalDescriptionDocument grounded copy, CVContentSnapshotDocument immutable snapshots)
ObjectStorage = private binary storage (presigned upload intent with short TTL, safe UUID object keys, magic-byte binary validation, private PDF storage)
Portfolio aggregate stored in MongoDB; submitted revisions remain permanently immutable
Canonical tags controlled by PostgreSQL catalog (3–5 tags enforced strictly on server side)
Teacher authorization strictly scoped to active class assignments within tenant; non-assigned teachers cannot view queue or validate
Teacher validation decisions use relational two-phase application (pending -> atomic Mongo transition -> applied/failed with reconciliation)
Soft skill rubrics enforced across 5 canonical dimensions (1..5 integer score) strictly persisted in relational source of truth

Approved evidence snapshot documents projected to MongoDB upon teacher approval; radar visualization computes deterministically from approved snapshots only (0-100 scale, saturation at 5 units, tag stacking deduplicated)
School Admin authority is strictly tenant-scoped (school_id derived from server session, never browser request payload; no global admin authority)
User deletion uses lifecycle state (active/disabled) with immediate session revocation, preserving historical evidence and audit events; no hard deletion
Temporary credentials generated securely via secrets.token_urlsafe, returned only once, stored as Argon2id hashes, and enforce must_change_password server gate
Class and enrollment history strictly preserved upon student transfers or archival (status=active/archived, no destructive DELETE)
Teacher assignments control future validator queue scope; removal of assignment revokes review visibility without mutating historical decisions
School analytics computed strictly from teacher-approved evidence snapshots; unapproved drafts, submissions, revisions, and rejections count zero
Talent heatmap primary metric is evidence coverage rate (proportion of cohort with >= 1 approved evidence item in dimension); secondary metric is mean evidence index
Student-level evidence index computes deterministically across cohort with tag-stacking prevention and saturation at 5 units
Teacher rubric aggregates (initiative, collaboration, communication, responsibility, resilience) remain strictly separate from evidence radar
School analytics enforces minimum group privacy threshold (>= 5 unique students) applied after filtering; small cohorts are suppressed; true zero and suppressed states are distinct
Recommendation = deterministic, evidence-based, advisory ('bidang yang dapat dieksplorasi'); zero high-impact decision use, zero admissions/employability/IQ predictions
Only approved evidence contributes to recommendations; drafts, submitted, revision_requested, and rejected work contribute zero
No protected traits used or inferred (gender, race, religion, health, socio-economic status, demographic proxies)

Match score != confidence: match score measures alignment with 6 radar dimensions, canonical tags, and rubric; confidence measures evidence volume, breadth across dimensions, and longitudinal span across period buckets
Proof-of-work primary (60% radar + 20% tags), rubric secondary (20%); missing rubric re-normalizes available components (75% radar, 25% tags) without penalizing student
Repetition cap (max 2 units per tag per period bucket) prevents upload gaming; longitudinal evidence across multiple periods drives higher confidence
Recommendation catalog versioned (career-catalog-v1, recommendation-v1, mapping-v1) and strictly validated (weights sum to 1.0, non-negative)
Recommendation snapshots immutable and persisted in MongoDB with staleness fingerprinting for deterministic idempotency
LLM/generative text cannot rank careers, modify match scores, or invent paths; deterministic engine is sole authority

Industry translator must preserve facts (who, what, when, scope, tools, outcomes); factuality guard prevents invented metrics, ungrounded technologies, or unsupported leadership claims with deterministic fallback
Derived professional copy stored separately in derived snapshots; immutable portfolio revision text is never mutated
Point-in-time immutable CV snapshot stored in MongoDB (cv_content_snapshots) with canonical SHA-256 snapshot digest and short human-friendly fingerprint (TLN-XXXX-XXXX)
CV selection policy strictly bounded to 1–8 teacher-approved portfolio items only; unapproved, draft, revision-requested, or rejected works strictly rejected
ReportLab deterministic PDF rendering engine generating real searchable/selectable text (A4, brand palette, max 2 pages, embedded QR code, zero personal contact/identifier leakage)
Private object storage for rendered CV PDFs with safe UUID-based keys (zero PII in key paths)
High-entropy opaque verification tokens (secrets.token_urlsafe(32)) stored ONLY as HMAC-SHA256 digests (token_hash) with server pepper; raw tokens never persisted in database

Public verification API (GET /api/v1/public/verify/{token}) with strict rate limiting, zero PII exposure (no NISN, NIP, NPSN, UUIDs), and explicit verification statuses (verified, expired, revoked, invalid)
Multi-tenant revocation lifecycle: students may revoke their own CVs; same-school admins may revoke student CVs within their tenant with mandatory reason
Phase 9 Release Readiness: Complete E2E integration across all 3 roles (Student, Teacher, Admin) verified

Production Security: CSRF tokens, strict Argon2id hashing, HMAC-SHA256 identity lookups, session revocation on credential changes, server-enforced must_change_password gate, and zero PII/secret exposure in logs or public verify responses

Observability: Liveness probe (/health/live) and readiness probe (/health/ready) inspecting postgres, mongo, and storage without leaking credentials or internal topology; structured audit logging for sensitive actions

Persistence & Disaster Recovery: Multi-store backup and restore procedure documented (PostgreSQL pg_dump logical backups, MongoDB mongodump BSON snapshots, S3 bucket versioning & replication); point-in-time recovery strategy without cross-database ACID assumptions

Deployment & CI/CD: Automated linting, typecheck, Next.js build (all 18 routes static/dynamic verified), Python pytest suite (112 tests), and Phase 1-9 frontend/domain invariant test suites; zero-downtime blue/green deployment strategy with database migration backward-compatibility rollback plan
lastSummary: Phase 9 completed: Final Integration, Production Hardening, Observability, Persistence & Recovery, CI/CD, and Release Readiness fully verified. Security hardening verified for CSRF protection, Argon2id hashing, rate limiting, and zero credential/PII leakage in logs and public verification payloads. All 112 pytest suites passed (100%), all 7 frontend/domain invariant test suites (Phase 1-9) passed, Next.js build compiled all 18 routes cleanly with 0 type errors, kit validator passed with ok: true.
